cards.card_text: Into their ovens and kneading bowls Into their grain storehouses and barns Into their wells and water jars
cards.verse_text: The Nile will teem with frogs, and they will come into your palace and up to your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and your people, and into your ovens and kneading bowls.
cards.snippet: …houses of your officials and your people, and into your ovens and kneading bowls.

cards.card_text: In kneading bowls on their shoulders In clay jars on their donkeys In baskets loaded on their carts
cards.verse_text: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, carrying it on their shoulders in kneading bowls wrapped in clothing.
cards.snippet: …their dough before it was leavened, carrying it on their shoulders in kneading bowls wrapped in clothing.

cards.card_text: Their kneading bowl Their cooking pot Their water jar
cards.verse_text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
cards.snippet: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.

cards.card_text: Even the basket and the kneading bowl will be cursed, and friend, the kitchen is MY department.
cards.verse_text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
cards.snippet: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.

cards.card_text: In God's oven picture, what is the baker's oven like from the kneading to the rising of the dough?
cards.verse_text: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.
cards.snippet: …heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.
